data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Junud' meaning 'army'. The name Junaida signifies someone who is given by God and belongs to Him. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Junaida usually hope their child will grow to embody given by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
